entities.name: Daniel Kolář
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniel Kolář is a Czech former professional footballer who played as an attacking midfielder, spending most of his career with Viktoria Plzeň. At international level, he made 29 appearances for Czech Republic national team scoring twice. After his retirement, he continued at Viktoria Plzeň as a sport manager.
